answer.example_en: Housework takes less time when everyone helps.
answer.example_zh: 大家一起分担，家务就不会花那么多时间。
answer.usage_note: housework泛指家务劳动，通常不可数；chore则是单项家务。

answer.example_en: Taking out the trash is my least favorite chore.
answer.example_zh: 倒垃圾是我最不喜欢的家务活。
answer.usage_note: chore指一项通常需要定期完成的任务，可数。

answer.example_en: We use a chore chart to divide tasks among the family.
answer.example_zh: 我们用家务分工表给家庭成员分配任务。
answer.usage_note: chore chart用于记录由谁承担哪些家务，chart在这里是表格。

answer.example_en: We clean up the kitchen after dinner.
answer.example_zh: 晚饭后我们把厨房打扫干净。
answer.usage_note: clean up强调把脏乱环境恢复整洁。

answer.example_en: I scrub the sink to remove stubborn stains.
answer.example_zh: 我用力刷洗水槽，清除顽固污渍。
answer.usage_note: scrub强调用力擦洗，通常比wipe更费力。

answer.example_en: I sweep the floor before I mop it.
answer.example_zh: 我先扫地，然后拖地。
answer.usage_note: sweep是扫帚扫，区别于vacuum吸尘。

answer.example_en: I mop the kitchen floor every weekend.
answer.example_zh: 我每周末拖一次厨房地板。
answer.usage_note: mop作动词为拖地，亦可作名词拖把。

answer.example_en: I vacuum the living room twice a week.
answer.example_zh: 我每周给客厅吸尘两次。
answer.usage_note: vacuum在这里是用吸尘器打扫。

answer.example_en: I dust the furniture before vacuuming.
answer.example_zh: 吸尘前我先给家具除尘。
answer.usage_note: dust在此作动词清灰；名词dust是灰尘。

answer.example_en: I clean the litter box every day.
answer.example_zh: 我每天都清理猫砂盆。
answer.usage_note: litter box是猫砂盆；litter在其他语境还可表示垃圾。

answer.example_en: I rinsed the mop after cleaning the kitchen floor.
answer.example_zh: 拖完厨房地板后，我冲洗了拖把。
answer.usage_note: mop在这里是名词“拖把”；也可作动词“拖地”。

answer.example_en: The vacuum cleaner is in the hall closet.
answer.example_zh: 吸尘器放在走廊壁橱里。
answer.usage_note: vacuum cleaner指吸尘器设备，vacuum可作口语简称。

answer.example_en: I used a scrub brush to clean the tiles.
answer.example_zh: 我用硬毛刷刷洗了瓷砖。
answer.usage_note: scrub brush用于较用力的刷洗，软布则适合轻轻擦拭。

answer.example_en: Use the detergent recommended for this fabric.
answer.example_zh: 请使用适合这种面料的洗涤剂。
answer.usage_note: detergent是洗涤剂的统称，不限于洗衣液。

answer.example_en: We're almost out of laundry detergent.
answer.example_zh: 我们的洗衣液快用完了。
answer.usage_note: laundry detergent专指洗衣用的洗涤剂，可为液体或粉末。

answer.example_en: Please put a new trash bag in the kitchen bin.
answer.example_zh: 请给厨房垃圾桶套上新垃圾袋。
answer.usage_note: trash bag为美式常用表达，英式常用bin bag。

answer.example_en: I carried the laundry basket upstairs.
answer.example_zh: 我把洗衣篮搬上了楼。
collocations: put clothes in the laundry basket
answer.usage_note: laundry basket是洗衣篮，可放脏衣物或搬运干净衣物。

answer.example_en: I keep cleaning supplies in a locked cabinet.
answer.example_zh: 我把清洁用品存放在上锁的柜子里。
answer.usage_note: cleaning supplies指各种清洁用品，含工具和清洁剂。

answer.example_en: We have a chore rotation so everyone takes turns.
answer.example_zh: 我们实行家务轮换，让每个人轮流负责。
answer.usage_note: chore rotation指任务按周期轮换，不是同一人长期固定负责。

answer.example_en: I sweep the kitchen floor after breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早饭后我会扫厨房地板。
answer.usage_note: sweep指扫除地面碎屑，与mop拖地不同。

answer.example_en: I vacuum the living room every weekend.
answer.example_zh: 我每个周末给客厅吸尘。
answer.usage_note: vacuum此处作动词，表示用吸尘器清洁客厅。

answer.example_en: I wait for the stovetop to cool before I clean it.
answer.example_zh: 我等炉灶台冷却后再清洁。
answer.usage_note: stovetop是炉灶上表面；不同灶具须遵守产品清洁说明。

answer.example_en: I clean the microwave after spills and splatters.
answer.example_zh: 微波炉里溅了东西之后，我会把它清理干净。
answer.usage_note: microwave在此指微波炉设备，不是微波这一物理概念。

answer.example_en: I scrub the sink with a soft brush.
answer.example_zh: 我用软刷把水槽刷干净。
answer.usage_note: scrub比wipe更强调擦洗用力；根据表面材料选合适工具。

answer.example_en: It's my turn to clean the toilet this week.
answer.example_zh: 这周轮到我清洁马桶。
answer.usage_note: clean the toilet通常指清洁马桶本身。

answer.example_en: I scrub the bathtub after soaking it with water.
answer.example_zh: 把浴缸浸湿后，我会刷洗浴缸。
answer.usage_note: scrub the bathtub强调刷洗浴缸，不等于冲淋或简单擦干。

answer.example_en: We clean the shower tiles to remove soap residue.
answer.example_zh: 我们清洁淋浴区瓷砖，去掉肥皂残留。
answer.usage_note: shower tiles指淋浴区域的墙砖或地砖。

answer.example_en: Don't forget to take out the garbage tonight.
answer.example_zh: 今晚别忘了把垃圾拿出去。
answer.usage_note: garbage与trash在美式英语中意义接近，代词用take it out。

answer.example_en: I clean the vents when dust builds up around them.
answer.example_zh: 通风口附近积灰时，我会清理它们。
answer.usage_note: vents指通风口；电器及风管内部清洁应遵守设备安全要求。

answer.example_en: The vacuum cleaner works better after I clean the filter.
answer.example_zh: 清洁滤网后，吸尘器工作效果好多了。
answer.usage_note: filter是滤网，须按吸尘器说明书确定能否水洗。

answer.example_en: I try to clean as I go when cooking.
answer.example_zh: 做饭时我尽量边做边收拾。
collocations: clean as you go in the kitchen
answer.usage_note: clean as you go指进行活动时及时清理；此项为源增补候选，仍待独立审查。

answer.example_en: Everyone in the house should help with household chores.
answer.example_zh: 家里每个人都应该帮忙做家务。
answer.usage_note: household chores强调家庭中的多项具体杂务。

answer.example_en: I do most of the cleaning on Saturday.
answer.example_zh: 我大部分打扫工作都在周六完成。
answer.usage_note: cleaning在这里是名词，指打扫清洁这一活动。

answer.example_en: A little daily tidying keeps the room manageable.
answer.example_zh: 每天稍微整理一下，房间就不容易乱。
answer.usage_note: tidying侧重收拾整齐，未必包含去污和消毒。

answer.example_en: The kitchen needs deep cleaning before the holidays.
answer.example_zh: 节日前厨房需要彻底清洁一次。
answer.usage_note: deep cleaning指比日常表面清洁更全面的清洁。

answer.example_en: We do spring cleaning when the weather warms up.
answer.example_zh: 天气转暖时，我们会进行一次大扫除。
answer.usage_note: spring cleaning是惯用说法，可泛指阶段性大扫除，不限春季。

answer.example_en: Regular maintenance helps the washing machine last longer.
answer.example_zh: 定期保养有助于延长洗衣机的使用寿命。
answer.usage_note: maintenance在此为设备或家居的维护保养，不同于日常清洁。

answer.example_en: Household upkeep includes cleaning and small repairs.
answer.example_zh: 家居维护包括打扫和小修小补。
answer.usage_note: household upkeep指维持住所良好状态的一系列工作。

answer.example_en: I do the chores before relaxing in the evening.
answer.example_zh: 晚上休息前我先把家务做了。
answer.usage_note: do the chores强调执行那些具体家务任务。

answer.example_en: We share the chores so no one does everything.
answer.example_zh: 我们分担家务，避免所有事都落在一人身上。
answer.usage_note: share the chores表示共同承担家务，不要求每人做完全相同的工作。

answer.example_en: My roommate and I split the chores evenly.
answer.example_zh: 我和室友把家务平均分工。
answer.usage_note: split强调把不同任务分配给不同人或按比例分担。

answer.example_en: We assign chores based on everyone's schedule.
answer.example_zh: 我们根据每个人的日程分配家务。
answer.usage_note: assign A to B意为把任务A分配给B。

answer.example_en: We put a cleaning schedule on the fridge.
answer.example_zh: 我们把清洁安排表贴在冰箱上。
answer.usage_note: cleaning schedule说明打扫的日期、频率或负责人。

answer.example_en: Making the bed is one of my daily chores.
answer.example_zh: 整理床铺是我的日常家务之一。
answer.usage_note: daily表示每天进行的，不是偶尔的大扫除。

answer.example_en: I save bigger jobs for my weekly chores.
answer.example_zh: 我把较费时的工作留到每周家务时间做。
answer.usage_note: weekly chores指每周定期安排的家务，而非每天做的任务。

answer.example_en: I wrote a to-do list for the weekend cleaning.
answer.example_zh: 我列了一张周末打扫的待办清单。
answer.usage_note: to-do list是待办清单，任务完成后可用check off。

answer.example_en: We tidy up the kitchen after every meal.
answer.example_zh: 我们每顿饭后都会把厨房收拾整齐。
answer.usage_note: tidy up着重收拾物品、恢复整齐，与deep clean不同。

answer.example_en: I wipe down the counters after cooking.
answer.example_zh: 做完饭后我会擦拭台面。
answer.usage_note: wipe down表示擦拭整个表面。

answer.example_en: I polish the wooden table with a suitable product.
answer.example_zh: 我用适当的护理产品擦亮木桌。
answer.usage_note: polish在此为擦亮或上光，不只是一般清洁。

rows.gloss: 清洁并减少表面微生物数量（不等于彻底灭菌）

answer.meaning_zh: 清洁并减少表面微生物数量（不等于彻底灭菌）
answer.example_en: We sanitize food-contact surfaces after cleaning them.
answer.example_zh: 清洁后，我们会对接触食物的表面进行卫生处理。
answer.usage_note: sanitize侧重将微生物数量降到较安全水平，并非彻底灭菌。

rows.gloss: 消毒；杀灭表面大部分致病微生物

answer.meaning_zh: 消毒；杀灭表面大部分致病微生物
answer.example_en: Disinfect high-touch surfaces according to the product label.
answer.example_zh: 按照产品标签说明，对经常触摸的表面进行消毒。
answer.usage_note: disinfect侧重杀灭或灭活表面致病微生物；不可随意混合清洁剂。

answer.example_en: Rinse the dishes thoroughly after washing them by hand.
answer.example_zh: 手洗餐具后把它们彻底冲干净。
answer.usage_note: rinse强调用水冲掉肥皂或残留物，不一定包含刷洗。

answer.example_en: I soak the stained pan before scrubbing it.
answer.example_zh: 我先把有污渍的锅泡一泡，再刷洗。
answer.usage_note: soak表示浸泡一段时间以便清洁。

answer.example_en: I hang out the laundry when the weather is dry.
answer.example_zh: 天气干燥时我把洗好的衣服挂出去晾。
answer.usage_note: hang out the laundry指挂到室外或晾衣处晾干；hang out还有社交义。

answer.example_en: I fold the laundry as soon as it's dry.
answer.example_zh: 衣服一晾干，我就把它们叠好。
answer.usage_note: laundry在此是洗好的衣物，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I iron my shirts on Sunday evening.
answer.example_zh: 周日晚上我会熨衬衫。
answer.usage_note: iron此处是动词“熨”，也可指熨斗。

answer.example_en: Could you take out the trash before dinner?
answer.example_zh: 晚饭前你能把垃圾拿出去吗？
answer.usage_note: take out the trash是美式常见表达，英式常说take out the rubbish。

answer.example_en: We wash the dishes right after eating.
answer.example_zh: 我们吃完饭马上洗碗。
answer.usage_note: wash the dishes指洗餐具，不局限于盘子。

answer.example_en: Please load the dishwasher after breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早饭后请把餐具放进洗碗机。
collocations: load dirty dishes into the dishwasher
answer.usage_note: load表示把待洗的碗碟装入机器，与empty相反。

answer.example_en: I empty the dishwasher once the dishes are cool and dry.
answer.example_zh: 餐具冷却并干燥后，我把洗碗机里的东西取出来。
answer.usage_note: empty the dishwasher指取出清洗完的餐具，不是把废水倒掉。

answer.example_en: I make the bed right after breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早饭后我马上整理床铺。
answer.usage_note: make the bed指整理床单被褥，不是制造一张床。

answer.example_en: We change the sheets every Sunday.
answer.example_zh: 我们每周日换床单。
answer.usage_note: sheets在这里指床单，常用复数。

answer.example_en: I water the plants before leaving for work.
answer.example_zh: 上班前我给植物浇水。
answer.usage_note: water在此为动词“浇水”，作名词则是水。

answer.example_en: My brother feeds the pets every morning.
answer.example_zh: 我弟弟每天早上给宠物喂食。
answer.usage_note: feed后直接接接受喂食的动物。

answer.example_en: I need to run errands after lunch.
answer.example_zh: 午饭后我得出门办几件杂事。
answer.usage_note: run errands指外出办理购物、寄件等日常事务，不是跑步。

answer.example_en: The broom is behind the kitchen door.
answer.example_zh: 扫帚放在厨房门后。
answer.usage_note: broom是扫帚，sweep表示扫的动作。

answer.example_en: Sweep the crumbs into the dustpan.
answer.example_zh: 把碎屑扫进簸箕里。
answer.usage_note: dustpan指配合扫帚收集灰尘的簸箕。

answer.example_en: Fill the bucket with warm water.
answer.example_zh: 往水桶里装些温水。
answer.usage_note: bucket是水桶，通常可数。

answer.example_en: The robot vacuum cleans the hallway while I'm at work.
answer.example_zh: 我上班时扫地机器人会清扫走廊。
answer.usage_note: robot vacuum是自动地面吸尘设备，不必然具备拖地功能。

answer.example_en: I use a microfiber cloth to wipe the screen.
answer.example_zh: 我用超细纤维布擦屏幕。
answer.usage_note: microfiber cloth指超细纤维布，应遵守屏幕清洁要求。

answer.example_en: I use a soft sponge to wash the dishes.
answer.example_zh: 我用柔软的海绵洗碗。
answer.usage_note: sponge是海绵，可用于清洁，也有其他语境义项。

answer.example_en: I use a duster to reach the top of the bookshelf.
answer.example_zh: 我用除尘掸清理书架顶上的灰。
answer.usage_note: duster是除尘工具；dust可作动词表示掸灰。

answer.example_en: I grabbed a paper towel to absorb the spill.
answer.example_zh: 我拿了一张厨房纸巾吸干洒出的液体。
answer.usage_note: paper towel是吸水纸巾，区别于可反复使用的布毛巾。

answer.example_en: I keep a cleaning rag under the sink.
answer.example_zh: 我在水槽下面放着一块清洁抹布。
answer.usage_note: rag在此是用于擦拭的旧布或抹布，通常可数。

answer.example_en: Put on rubber gloves before handling the cleaner.
answer.example_zh: 接触清洁剂前先戴上橡胶手套。
answer.usage_note: rubber gloves用于保护双手，须按产品标签选择合适防护。

answer.example_en: I put on an apron before scrubbing the kitchen.
answer.example_zh: 刷洗厨房前我穿上围裙。
answer.usage_note: apron是围裙，常用于防止衣服弄脏。

answer.example_en: I use an all-purpose cleaner on suitable kitchen surfaces.
answer.example_zh: 我在适用的厨房表面使用多用途清洁剂。
answer.usage_note: all-purpose cleaner可用于多种表面，但应核对产品说明，并非适合所有材质。

answer.example_en: This glass cleaner leaves the mirror clear.
answer.example_zh: 这种玻璃清洁剂能把镜子擦得透亮。
answer.usage_note: glass cleaner专用于玻璃等适用表面，不代表具有消毒功效。

answer.example_en: Choose a floor cleaner suitable for wooden floors.
answer.example_zh: 要选适合木地板的地板清洁剂。
answer.usage_note: floor cleaner要与地板材质相容，并遵照说明稀释或使用。

answer.example_en: We're running low on dish soap.
answer.example_zh: 我们的洗碗液快用完了。
answer.usage_note: dish soap常指手洗餐具用的洗洁精，不等于洗碗机专用洗涤剂。

answer.example_en: I skipped fabric softener for these towels.
answer.example_zh: 洗这些毛巾时我没用衣物柔顺剂。
answer.usage_note: fabric softener用于柔顺织物，不是去污主洗涤剂。

answer.example_en: I applied a stain remover before washing the shirt.
answer.example_zh: 洗衬衫前我先用了去渍剂。
answer.usage_note: stain remover用于处理污渍，须确认面料适用性。

answer.example_en: Store bleach away from children and never mix it with other cleaners.
answer.example_zh: 漂白剂要放在儿童接触不到的地方，绝不能与其他清洁剂混用。
answer.usage_note: bleach是漂白剂统称；尤其含氯漂白剂不可与酸或氨类产品混合。

answer.example_en: Use disinfectant according to the label instructions.
answer.example_zh: 使用消毒剂时要按照标签说明操作。
answer.usage_note: disinfectant旨在消毒；与普通清洁剂、洗涤剂用途不同。

answer.example_en: Baking soda is stored in the kitchen cupboard.
answer.example_zh: 小苏打放在厨房柜子里。
answer.usage_note: baking soda是碳酸氢钠，不等于baking powder泡打粉。

answer.example_en: Some people use vinegar for suitable household cleaning tasks.
answer.example_zh: 有些人会用醋清洁适合的家居表面。
answer.usage_note: vinegar为酸性液体，不适用于所有材质，也绝不可与含氯漂白剂混合。

answer.example_en: The garbage can is full, so I'll empty it.
answer.example_zh: 垃圾桶满了，我去倒一下。
answer.usage_note: garbage can为美式常见垃圾桶说法，英式常说rubbish bin。

answer.example_en: Put clean cardboard in the recycling bin.
answer.example_zh: 把干净纸板放进回收桶。
collocations: put paper in the recycling bin
answer.usage_note: recycling bin是分类回收容器，实际可回收物应遵守当地规定。

answer.example_en: We put food scraps in the compost bin.
answer.example_zh: 我们把厨余碎屑放进堆肥桶。
answer.usage_note: compost bin用于可堆肥物，具体允许投放物品取决于当地规则。

answer.example_en: I loaded the dishwasher after dinner.
answer.example_zh: 晚饭后我把碗碟装进了洗碗机。
answer.usage_note: dishwasher是洗碗机，load表示把餐具放进去。

answer.example_en: The washing machine is running a short cycle.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机正在运行短洗程序。
answer.usage_note: washing machine指洗衣机，不等于烘干机dryer。

answer.example_en: I took the clothes out of the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 我把衣服从烘干机里拿了出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the dryer
answer.usage_note: dryer指烘干设备，美式常用；英式也称tumble dryer。

answer.example_en: We hung the sheets on the clothesline.
answer.example_zh: 我们把床单挂在晾衣绳上。
answer.usage_note: clothesline是用于晾晒衣物的绳索。

answer.example_en: I spread the shirts over the drying rack.
answer.example_zh: 我把衬衫摊挂在晾衣架上。
collocations: hang clothes on a drying rack
answer.usage_note: drying rack是晾衣架，不是烘干机。

answer.example_en: Make sure the iron has cooled before putting it away.
answer.example_zh: 收起熨斗前确认它已经冷却。
answer.usage_note: iron在此是名词熨斗，也可作动词熨烫。

answer.example_en: I unfolded the ironing board to press my shirt.
answer.example_zh: 我展开熨衣板准备熨衬衫。
answer.usage_note: ironing board是熨衣板，不是普通桌面。

answer.example_en: I use a lint roller to remove pet hair from the sofa.
answer.example_zh: 我用黏毛滚筒去掉沙发上的宠物毛。
answer.usage_note: lint roller通过黏附去除毛屑，常用于衣物和织物家具。

answer.example_en: We keep a plunger beside the toilet for emergencies.
answer.example_zh: 我们在马桶旁放着一个皮搋子以备不时之需。
answer.usage_note: plunger是疏通工具，不是化学疏通剂。

answer.example_en: Read the instructions before using any drain cleaner.
answer.example_zh: 使用任何管道疏通剂前，先阅读说明。
answer.usage_note: drain cleaner可能有腐蚀性，切勿混用清洁化学品。

answer.example_en: I carry my brushes and cloths in a cleaning caddy.
answer.example_zh: 我用清洁用品提篮装刷子和抹布。
collocations: carry supplies in a cleaning caddy
answer.usage_note: cleaning caddy用于集中携带清洁用品，caddy在此不是球童。

answer.example_en: The spare detergent is in the storage cupboard.
answer.example_zh: 备用洗涤剂放在储物柜里。
answer.usage_note: cupboard通常是有门储物柜，英式常用。

answer.example_en: My hands got dirty while cleaning the garage.
answer.example_zh: 打扫车库时，我的手弄脏了。
answer.usage_note: dirty指有污物、脏，不限于灰尘。

answer.example_en: The shelves are dusty because we rarely use that room.
answer.example_zh: 架子积了灰，因为我们很少用那个房间。
answer.usage_note: dusty指表面有灰尘，不等于沾油污greasy。

answer.example_en: The stovetop is greasy after frying food.
answer.example_zh: 煎完东西后炉灶台沾满油污。
answer.usage_note: greasy在清洁场景表示沾油脂而油腻。

answer.example_en: The floor feels sticky where the juice spilled.
answer.example_zh: 果汁洒过的地板摸起来黏黏的。
answer.usage_note: sticky指表面发黏，可由糖分或黏性残留造成。

answer.example_en: The tablecloth is stained with red wine.
answer.example_zh: 桌布沾上了红酒渍。
answer.usage_note: stained表示已经留下污渍，常接with描述污渍来源。

answer.example_en: The mirror looks smudged after someone touched it.
answer.example_zh: 有人摸过镜子后，表面留下了模糊污迹。
answer.usage_note: smudged常指抹开的污迹或指印，不一定是永久污渍。

answer.example_en: The neglected windows were grimy.
answer.example_zh: 久未清理的窗户积满污垢。
answer.usage_note: grimy形容积累了较厚污垢，比一般dirty更强烈。

answer.example_en: The kitchen drain is clogged with food scraps.
answer.example_zh: 厨房下水口被食物残渣堵住了。
answer.usage_note: clogged表示管道或开口堵塞，动词clog是堵住。

answer.example_en: The basement wall looks moldy after the leak.
answer.example_zh: 漏水后地下室墙面看起来发霉了。
answer.usage_note: moldy表示发霉，外观判断不等于专业检测结果。

answer.example_en: The towel is still damp, so leave it hanging.
answer.example_zh: 毛巾还有些潮，继续挂着晾吧。
answer.usage_note: damp通常表示微湿，程度一般比soaking wet轻。

answer.example_en: The closet smells musty because it hasn't been aired out.
answer.example_zh: 衣柜有股霉闷味，因为一直没通风。
answer.usage_note: musty常形容潮湿或不通风环境中的霉闷味，不必然证明有霉菌。

answer.example_en: The floor is wet, so watch your step.
answer.example_zh: 地板湿了，走路小心。
answer.usage_note: wet表示有水分，常比damp更湿。

answer.example_en: These towels are completely dry now.
answer.example_zh: 这些毛巾现在已经完全干了。
answer.usage_note: dry在此是形容词“干的”，也可作动词“弄干”。

answer.example_en: The bathroom was spotless after the cleaning.
answer.example_zh: 打扫后浴室一尘不染。
answer.usage_note: spotless强调非常干净，通常是褒义。

answer.example_en: The kitchen floor looks shiny after mopping.
answer.example_zh: 拖完后厨房地板看着亮闪闪的。
answer.usage_note: shiny描述发亮，未必意味着已消毒。

answer.example_en: The sink is squeaky clean after a thorough scrub.
answer.example_zh: 仔细刷洗后，水槽干净得发亮。
answer.usage_note: squeaky clean是口语强化表达，形容非常干净。

answer.example_en: The room was fresh-smelling after we opened the windows.
answer.example_zh: 打开窗户后，房间闻起来很清新。
answer.usage_note: fresh-smelling描述气味清新，不等于已去除所有污染源。

answer.example_en: The kitchen looks messy after the big meal.
answer.example_zh: 吃过大餐后，厨房看起来乱糟糟的。
answer.usage_note: messy泛指乱或脏，不只是积灰。

answer.example_en: I like to keep the living room tidy.
answer.example_zh: 我喜欢让客厅保持整洁。
answer.usage_note: tidy强调物品摆放整齐，不一定意味着深度清洁。

answer.example_en: My cleaning supplies are organized by purpose.
answer.example_zh: 我按用途把清洁用品整理得井井有条。
answer.usage_note: organized强调有系统、有条理地安排。

answer.example_en: Cleaning the oven is long overdue.
answer.example_zh: 烤箱早就该清洁了，一直拖到现在。
answer.usage_note: overdue表示超过应做的时间，不是日常意义上的迟到。

answer.example_en: Cleaning every window is time-consuming.
answer.example_zh: 擦完所有窗户很费时间。
answer.usage_note: time-consuming强调耗时，与难度高不完全相同。

answer.example_en: Folding the laundry feels repetitive.
answer.example_zh: 叠衣服让人觉得总在重复同样的动作。
answer.usage_note: repetitive侧重不断重复，未必一定枯燥。

answer.example_en: I find ironing clothes boring.
answer.example_zh: 我觉得熨衣服挺无聊。
answer.usage_note: boring形容事情令人无聊，bored形容人的感受。

answer.example_en: The housework feels manageable when we share it.
answer.example_zh: 我们分担家务后，工作量就变得可以应付了。
answer.usage_note: manageable表示在能力或时间范围内可以完成。

answer.example_en: Deep cleaning the whole house was exhausting.
answer.example_zh: 把整栋房子彻底打扫一遍真累人。
answer.usage_note: exhausting形容使人疲惫的事情，exhausted形容感到疲惫的人。

answer.example_en: Everyone should do their fair share of the chores.
answer.example_zh: 每个人都应该公平分担自己那份家务。
answer.usage_note: fair share指合理、公平承担的一部分，未必要求数量完全相等。

answer.example_en: We reduced the workload by splitting the cleaning tasks.
answer.example_zh: 我们分配清洁任务，减轻了各自的工作量。
answer.usage_note: workload指需要完成的工作量，家务场景中也常用。

answer.example_en: That stained tile needs some elbow grease.
answer.example_zh: 那块有污渍的瓷砖得费点力气刷洗。
answer.usage_note: elbow grease是习语，表示体力和费劲的擦洗，不是真正的油脂。

answer.example_en: This stubborn stain won't come out in the wash.
answer.example_zh: 这块顽固污渍洗的时候怎么也洗不掉。
answer.usage_note: stubborn在此形容污渍难以清除，不是人的倔强。

answer.example_en: There's soap scum around the shower door.
answer.example_zh: 淋浴门边缘积了一层皂垢。
answer.usage_note: soap scum指肥皂等与水中矿物质形成的残留沉积。

answer.example_en: Limescale has built up around the faucet.
answer.example_zh: 水龙头周围积了水垢。
answer.usage_note: limescale主要来自硬水矿物质沉积，与油污grease不同。

answer.example_en: I noticed grease buildup near the stove.
answer.example_zh: 我发现炉灶附近积了不少油污。
answer.usage_note: grease buildup强调油脂逐渐积累。

answer.example_en: There's pet hair all over the sofa.
answer.example_zh: 沙发上到处都是宠物毛。
answer.usage_note: pet hair泛指宠物掉落的毛发，通常作为集合名词。

answer.example_en: Sweep the crumbs off the kitchen floor.
answer.example_zh: 把厨房地板上的食物碎屑扫掉。
answer.usage_note: crumbs通常是面包或其他食物的小碎屑，常用复数。

answer.example_en: The dryer filter is full of lint.
answer.example_zh: 烘干机滤网上积满了毛絮。
answer.usage_note: lint是纤维毛絮，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: Dust mites can live in bedding and soft furnishings.
answer.example_zh: 尘螨可能生活在寝具和软质家具里。
answer.usage_note: dust mites指微小螨类，不等同于肉眼可见的灰尘团。

answer.example_en: Wipe up the spilled liquid before someone slips.
answer.example_zh: 赶快擦干洒出的液体，以免有人滑倒。
answer.usage_note: spilled是修饰liquid的过去分词形容词。

answer.example_en: Scrape food scraps into the appropriate bin.
answer.example_zh: 把食物残渣刮进相应的垃圾桶。
answer.usage_note: food scraps指剩下的食物碎屑或厨余残渣。

answer.example_en: We sort household waste into separate containers.
answer.example_zh: 我们把生活垃圾分类放进不同容器。
answer.usage_note: household waste指家庭产生的垃圾，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: Keep the recyclables separate from ordinary trash.
answer.example_zh: 把可回收物与普通垃圾分开放。
answer.usage_note: recyclables是可回收物的复数名词，具体范围依当地规则。

answer.example_en: We add vegetable peels to the compost.
answer.example_zh: 我们把蔬菜皮加入堆肥。
answer.usage_note: compost是堆肥或堆肥物料，也可作动词。

answer.example_en: I'll mop the hallway after sweeping it.
answer.example_zh: 扫完走廊后我会拖地。
answer.usage_note: mop是拖地动作，强调用拖把清洁。

answer.example_en: I dust the furniture before vacuuming the room.
answer.example_zh: 我给房间吸尘前先擦掉家具上的灰。
answer.usage_note: dust作动词是除灰；furniture是不可数集合名词。

answer.example_en: I wipe the countertops after preparing dinner.
answer.example_zh: 做完晚饭后，我会擦拭台面。
answer.usage_note: countertop指厨房或其他工作台的表面。

answer.example_en: We degrease the oven when grease starts to build up.
answer.example_zh: 烤箱油污开始堆积时，我们会进行除油清洁。
answer.usage_note: degrease指去除油脂；应根据材质及设备说明选择清洁方法。

answer.example_en: I wipe the fridge shelves before putting the food back.
answer.example_zh: 把食物放回冰箱前，我会擦净隔板。
answer.usage_note: fridge是refrigerator的常见口语缩略形式。

answer.example_en: The old freezer needs to be defrosted.
answer.example_zh: 这台旧冷冻柜需要除霜。
answer.usage_note: defrost在此指去除冷冻室结霜，具体操作须按设备说明。

answer.example_en: I polish the faucet to remove water marks.
answer.example_zh: 我把水龙头擦亮，去掉水印。
answer.usage_note: polish强调擦亮表面，faucet是美式水龙头，英式常用tap。

answer.example_en: Please wipe the bathroom mirror after your shower.
answer.example_zh: 淋浴后请把浴室镜子擦一擦。
answer.usage_note: wipe是擦拭表面，不等于清洗整个浴室。

answer.example_en: We wash the windows in spring.
answer.example_zh: 我们春天会擦洗窗户。
answer.usage_note: wash指用水或清洁液清洗，和只用干布擦的wipe有区别。

answer.example_en: I use a soft brush to dust the blinds.
answer.example_zh: 我用软刷给百叶帘除灰。
answer.usage_note: blinds指百叶帘等遮光帘，通常用复数。

answer.example_en: We change the bedding every week.
answer.example_zh: 我们每周更换床上用品。
answer.usage_note: bedding是床上用品的集合名词，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I wash the sheets on a gentle cycle.
answer.example_zh: 我用轻柔程序洗床单。
answer.usage_note: sheets通常指床单，洗涤程序应符合洗护标签。

answer.example_en: I strip the bed before washing the bedding.
answer.example_zh: 洗床上用品前，我先把床单和被套拆下来。
answer.usage_note: strip the bed指把床品撤下来，绝非将床拆开。

answer.example_en: I sort the laundry before starting the washing machine.
answer.example_zh: 开洗衣机前我先给脏衣服分类。
answer.usage_note: sort the laundry指将待洗衣物按颜色、材质等分类。

answer.example_en: I separate whites and colors to avoid color transfer.
answer.example_zh: 我把白衣和彩衣分开，以免串色。
answer.usage_note: whites和colors在这里均指相应颜色的衣服，常用复数。

answer.example_en: I start a wash cycle after adding the detergent.
answer.example_zh: 加入洗涤剂后我启动洗衣程序。
answer.usage_note: wash cycle是洗衣机的一次洗涤程序。

answer.example_en: I transfer the laundry to the dryer after the wash finishes.
answer.example_zh: 洗完后我把衣物转移到烘干机里。
answer.usage_note: transfer A to B表示把A移到B，需留意衣物能否烘干。

answer.example_en: I hang clothes to dry instead of using the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 我把衣服挂起来晾干，而不是用烘干机。
answer.usage_note: hang to dry指悬挂自然晾干，需参考衣物洗护标签。

answer.example_en: I fold clean clothes as soon as they are dry.
answer.example_zh: 衣服一干，我就把干净衣服叠好。
answer.usage_note: fold是折叠，clean修饰已经洗净的衣物。

answer.example_en: I put away laundry before going to bed.
answer.example_zh: 睡觉前我把洗好的衣服收好。
answer.usage_note: put away指把物品放回收纳位置，代词放在动词与away之间。

answer.example_en: I iron shirts on Sunday evening for the workweek.
answer.example_zh: 周日晚上我熨衬衫，为工作日做准备。
answer.usage_note: iron作动词指熨烫，熨烫温度须遵守洗护标签。

answer.example_en: Replace the bin liner after emptying the kitchen bin.
answer.example_zh: 倒空厨房垃圾桶后，换上新的垃圾袋。
collocations: put in a fresh bin liner
answer.usage_note: bin liner为英式常见的垃圾桶内衬袋说法。

answer.example_en: We sort the recycling before collection day.
answer.example_zh: 垃圾回收日前，我们会把可回收物分类。
answer.usage_note: recycling在这里指待回收物，实际分类规则依当地规定。

rows.gloss: 把垃圾桶推出去待收运

answer.meaning_zh: 把垃圾桶推出去待收运
answer.example_en: We put out the bins on Tuesday night.
answer.example_zh: 星期二晚上我们把垃圾桶推出去等收运。
answer.usage_note: put out the bins是英式常见说法，表示将垃圾桶移到收运地点。

answer.example_en: Don't forget to bring the bins back in after collection.
answer.example_zh: 垃圾收走后，别忘了把垃圾桶收回来。
answer.usage_note: bring back in表示从室外收运地点移回室内或存放区。

answer.example_en: I wash the dishes by hand when the dishwasher is full.
answer.example_zh: 洗碗机满了时，我会手洗碗碟。
answer.usage_note: by hand强调不用洗碗机，而是人工清洗。

answer.example_en: Rinse the dishes well before putting them on the rack.
answer.example_zh: 把碗碟充分冲净后再放到架子上。
answer.usage_note: rinse是用水冲掉残留物，不等于用洗涤剂刷洗。

answer.example_en: I dry the dishes with a clean towel.
answer.example_zh: 我用干净毛巾把碗碟擦干。
answer.usage_note: dry作动词为弄干，可以擦干或让其自然晾干。

answer.example_en: Please put dishes away after they are dry.
answer.example_zh: 碗碟干了之后请放回橱柜。
answer.usage_note: put away强调收回指定位置，与单纯从桌上移开不同。

answer.example_en: I change the air filter according to the manufacturer's schedule.
answer.example_zh: 我按厂家的建议周期更换空气滤芯。
answer.usage_note: air filter是空气过滤器滤芯，换新前应遵循设备说明。

answer.example_en: We need to replace a light bulb in the hallway.
answer.example_zh: 走廊里有个灯泡需要更换。
answer.usage_note: light bulb是灯泡；更换前应关闭电源并确认灯具安全。

answer.example_en: I wash the doormat when it gets muddy.
answer.example_zh: 门垫沾满泥时，我会把它清洗干净。
answer.usage_note: doormat是门口地垫，清洗方法随材质而异。

answer.example_en: I shake out the rug outdoors to remove loose dust.
answer.example_zh: 我把小地毯拿到室外抖掉浮灰。
collocations: shake dust out of a rug
answer.usage_note: shake out指通过抖动将灰尘或碎屑抖落。

answer.example_en: I water the houseplants after checking the soil.
answer.example_zh: 检查土壤后，我给室内植物浇水。
answer.usage_note: houseplants指室内盆栽植物，不同植物需水量不同。

answer.example_en: Wipe up a spill quickly so no one slips.
answer.example_zh: 液体洒出来要赶快擦干，以免有人滑倒。
answer.usage_note: wipe up指擦去或吸干洒出的液体。

answer.example_en: I'll spot-clean the carpet rather than wash the whole thing.
answer.example_zh: 我会局部清洗地毯，而不是整块洗。
answer.usage_note: spot-clean表示只清洁污渍所在的小区域。

answer.example_en: Check for leaks under the sink once in a while.
answer.example_zh: 偶尔检查一下水槽下面有没有漏水。
answer.usage_note: check for表示检查某问题是否存在；leak可指漏水处或漏水现象。

answer.example_en: This pan has stubborn grease around the edges.
answer.example_zh: 这口锅边缘有难清除的顽固油污。
answer.usage_note: stubborn在此表示很难清除，不是形容人的固执。

answer.example_en: The blocked drain is making the water back up.
answer.example_zh: 排水管堵了，水开始倒灌积起来。
answer.usage_note: blocked drain是堵塞的排水管；英式blocked、美式clogged均常见。

answer.example_en: Turn off the tap if the sink is overflowing.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗手池里的水正在溢出，就把水龙头关掉。
answer.usage_note: overflowing强调水位溢出边缘，须先停止供水。

answer.example_en: Our broken vacuum needs to be repaired or replaced.
answer.example_zh: 坏掉的吸尘器需要修理或更换。
answer.usage_note: vacuum在家务口语中可单独指吸尘器。

answer.example_en: I replaced the full dust bag before vacuuming again.
answer.example_zh: 我换掉装满灰的集尘袋后，才继续吸尘。
answer.usage_note: dust bag是某些吸尘器的集尘袋，与无袋型的dust container不同。

answer.example_en: A clogged filter can reduce the vacuum's suction.
answer.example_zh: 滤网堵塞会降低吸尘器的吸力。
answer.usage_note: clogged指被灰尘等堵住，清理方式依设备说明。

answer.example_en: I stopped using the leaking washing machine and called for help.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机漏水后，我停止使用并找人维修。
answer.usage_note: leaking表示正在漏水，涉及电器时应谨慎处理。

answer.example_en: This sweater came out of the wash with shrunk sleeves.
answer.example_zh: 这件毛衣洗完后，袖子缩水了。
answer.usage_note: shrunk是shrink的过去分词，指衣物尺寸因洗涤而缩小。

answer.example_en: Color bleeding ruined my white shirt in the wash.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣时串色，把我的白衬衫染坏了。
answer.usage_note: color bleeding指染料从衣物上脱落并沾到其他衣物，英式拼colour。

answer.example_en: This blouse has delicate fabric, so follow its care label.
answer.example_zh: 这件女式衬衫的面料很娇贵，洗护要看标签。
answer.usage_note: delicate fabric易在粗暴洗涤中受损。

answer.example_en: I tested the cleaner first to avoid a damaged surface.
answer.example_zh: 我先试了试清洁剂，避免损伤物体表面。
answer.usage_note: damaged surface指已经受到损害的表面，区别于普通污渍。

answer.example_en: Dragging furniture left a scratched floor.
answer.example_zh: 拖动家具把地板刮花了。
answer.usage_note: scratched强调划痕，通常不能靠简单擦拭去除。

answer.example_en: Be careful walking on slippery tiles after cleaning.
answer.example_zh: 清洁后瓷砖很滑，走路小心。
answer.usage_note: slippery表示易滑倒，应待地面干燥再正常通行。

answer.example_en: Open the windows if cleaning fumes build up, and leave the area if needed.
answer.example_zh: 如果清洁剂气体积聚，就开窗通风，必要时离开现场。
answer.usage_note: cleaning fumes指挥发性气体或刺激性气味；出现不适应停止接触。

answer.example_en: Rinse the surface as directed to remove chemical residue.
answer.example_zh: 按说明冲洗表面，去掉化学清洁剂残留。
answer.usage_note: chemical residue强调化学产品使用后残留的物质。

answer.example_en: The product caused skin irritation, so I stopped using it.
answer.example_zh: 这种产品刺激了我的皮肤，所以我停止使用。
answer.usage_note: skin irritation指皮肤受到刺激，并不自动等于过敏。

answer.example_en: She stopped using the cleaner after an allergic reaction.
answer.example_zh: 出现过敏反应后，她不再使用那种清洁剂。
answer.usage_note: allergic reaction是过敏反应，严重症状应及时就医。

answer.example_en: Wear protective gloves when the label recommends them.
answer.example_zh: 标签建议佩戴防护手套时，就应戴上。
answer.usage_note: protective gloves泛指防护手套，材质须与所接触产品相适配。

answer.example_en: Good ventilation matters when using some cleaning products.
answer.example_zh: 使用某些清洁产品时，良好通风很重要。
answer.usage_note: ventilation指空气流通，使用清洁剂时应遵循具体通风指引。

rows.gloss: 对宠物相对安全的清洁剂

answer.meaning_zh: 对宠物相对安全的清洁剂
answer.example_en: Choose a pet-safe cleaner and follow its instructions carefully.
answer.example_zh: 选择对宠物相对安全的清洁剂，并认真按说明使用。
answer.usage_note: pet-safe并不保证绝对无风险，仍须避免宠物接触未干表面。

answer.example_en: Check the care label before washing the wool sweater.
answer.example_zh: 洗羊毛毛衣前先查看洗护标签。
answer.usage_note: care label说明洗涤和干燥条件，不是尺码标签。

answer.example_en: Test on a small area before using the cleaner on the entire surface.
answer.example_zh: 清洁整块表面前，先在一小块地方试用。
collocations: test a cleaner on a hidden area
answer.usage_note: test on a small area旨在观察是否变色或损坏，宜先选不显眼处。

answer.example_en: Only dilute the cleaner if the label tells you to.
answer.example_zh: 只有标签要求时才稀释清洁剂。
answer.usage_note: dilute指加液体降低浓度，勿自行推测稀释比例。

answer.example_en: Follow the instructions on the bottle before cleaning.
answer.example_zh: 清洁前先遵循瓶身的使用说明。
answer.usage_note: instructions是具体操作说明，通常用复数。

answer.example_en: Don't mix cleaning products, especially bleach with other cleaners.
answer.example_zh: 不要混合清洁剂，尤其不要将漂白剂与其他清洁剂混用。
answer.usage_note: 此项是安全禁令；混合含氯漂白剂与酸或氨可产生危险气体。

answer.example_en: Rinse off residue only when the product instructions allow it.
answer.example_zh: 只有产品说明允许时才把残留物冲洗掉。
answer.usage_note: rinse off强调通过冲洗去掉附着物，具体应遵照产品标签。

answer.example_en: I used a plunger to unclog a drain.
answer.example_zh: 我用皮搋子疏通了下水口。
answer.usage_note: unclog指清除堵塞；避免随意混合管道清洁化学品。

answer.example_en: I empty the dust container after each cleaning session.
answer.example_zh: 每次打扫结束，我都会倒空集尘盒。
answer.usage_note: dust container指无袋吸尘器的集尘盒或集尘仓。

answer.example_en: I need to replace a mop head because the old one is worn out.
answer.example_zh: 旧拖把头磨损了，我得换个新的。
answer.usage_note: mop head是拖把头，可拆换型产品才能单独更换。

answer.example_en: We dealt with a spill before it reached the carpet.
answer.example_zh: 我们在液体流到地毯前就处理好了。
answer.usage_note: deal with表示采取措施处理问题，不限于擦拭这一个动作。

answer.example_en: I used a stain remover to remove a stain from my shirt.
answer.example_zh: 我用去渍剂去掉了衬衫上的污渍。
answer.usage_note: remove a stain指去除污渍，须遵照面料洗护要求。

rows.gloss: 在不明显部位测试面料

answer.meaning_zh: 在不明显部位测试面料
answer.example_en: Spot-test a fabric on a hidden seam first.
answer.example_zh: 先在面料不显眼的接缝处做小面积测试。
answer.usage_note: spot-test用于检验是否褪色或受损。

answer.example_en: Separate delicate clothes from heavy towels before washing.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣前把精细衣物和厚毛巾分开。
answer.usage_note: separate A from B表示将A与B分开。

answer.example_en: I hand-wash delicates when the label recommends it.
answer.example_zh: 标签建议时，我会手洗精细衣物。
answer.usage_note: delicates是需轻柔洗护的衣物。

answer.example_en: Dry clothes flat if the care label says so.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗护标签这样要求，就把衣服平铺晾干。
collocations: lay a sweater flat to dry
answer.usage_note: dry flat有助于避免某些衣物悬挂后变形。

rows.gloss: 化学品放到够不到的地方

answer.meaning_zh: 化学品放到够不到的地方
answer.example_en: Keep chemicals out of reach of children.
answer.example_zh: 把化学用品放在儿童够不到的地方。
collocations: keep out of reach of children
answer.usage_note: out of reach表示无法够到，危险物品应安全上锁。

answer.example_en: Store cleaning products safely in their original containers.
answer.example_zh: 把清洁剂装在原容器中妥善存放。
answer.usage_note: 清洁剂不应随意转装或混放。

answer.example_en: Dispose of used cleaning supplies as local rules require.
answer.example_zh: 按当地规定处理用过的清洁耗材。
answer.usage_note: dispose of表示妥善处理或丢弃。

answer.example_en: I asked a technician to fix an appliance.
answer.example_zh: 我请技术人员修理一台家电。
answer.usage_note: fix an appliance指修理家用电器，注意电气安全。

answer.example_en: I set a cleaning reminder for Saturday morning.
answer.example_zh: 我设了周六早晨打扫卫生的提醒。
answer.usage_note: set a reminder表示创建提醒，不表示任务已完成。

answer.example_en: We divide up the chores fairly among the three of us.
answer.example_zh: 我们三个人公平分担家务。
answer.usage_note: divide up指分配任务；该来源标记为待核验补缺候选。

answer.example_en: Doing a little daily helps me keep up with housework.
answer.example_zh: 每天做一点能让我及时完成家务。
answer.usage_note: keep up with强调不让任务积压；来源为待核验补缺候选。

answer.example_en: I do the housework before lunch on Sundays.
answer.example_zh: 周日午饭前我会做家务。
answer.usage_note: housework通常不可数；该源项为待独立验收增补候选。
